historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base scenario 10-year CAGR of look-through earnings FY2026E -> FY2036 (trough-recovery then fade); none of the historical CAGRs is a usable forward proxy
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (-25.8% 3yr) diverges from revenue (+1.5%) and EPS (-34.7%) because RMB 44bn of BBA stake-sale proceeds and dividends were returned as special dividends FY2023-25; book value is being run down by design, not by losses. Revenue CAGRs describe the minor subsidiaries only and say nothing about value.
historical_growth.notes: fcf_*_cagr fields hold the CAGR of the share of results of associates and JVs (the look-through earnings the model capitalises): FY2022 8,923.6 -> FY2025 2,504.2 (3yr) and FY2020 9,744.0 -> FY2025 2,504.2 (5yr). The FY2022 base still carried a full year of 25% BBA plus 50% for Jan-Feb; the decline since is the structural 50%->25% stake cut (Feb 2022) compounding BBA's own profit fall (17.5bn FY2024 -> 10.4bn FY2025 -> 3.9bn H1 FY2026). eps_5yr_cagr is null because FY2020 EPS was RMB 0.002 (a near-zero base makes the CAGR meaningless). Reported FCF is not used anywhere: BBA dividends are investing inflows.

scenario_narratives.base: The single axis is BBA's profit, i.e. BMW's China franchise. FY2026 is the trough: BMW's China sales fell 12.5% in 2025 and BBA's local volume a further 18.8% in H1 FY2026, with list-price cuts on 30+ models and BMW's 2026 auto EBIT margin guided to 1-3%. The Shenyang-built Neue Klasse iX3 (2026) and i3 successor (2027), fed by the completed RMB10bn battery plant, lift BBA's BEV mix enough to stabilise volume, and look-through earnings recover roughly 30% from the FY2026E base by FY2029 before fading 1%/yr as premium-ICE share keeps migrating to domestic NEV brands. The subsidiaries' drag narrows as JSA's restart and the Yuxin/TCL cockpit JV scale, but they never add value. Cash is returned (the company has paid out everything it does not redeploy), with 5% WHT leakage.
scenario_narratives.bull: Neue Klasse is a genuine reset: BBA's BEV mix moves toward 25-30%, BMW regains pricing discipline as weaker NEV entrants consolidate and the price war fades by 2028, and BBA's profit climbs back above FY2025's 10.4bn to ~12.5bn by FY2031. The JSA Jiyun NEV line and KD exports (Egypt, Vietnam, Saudi) turn the non-BMW segment to breakeven, and the market re-rates the holdco toward 8x look-through earnings. A sale of the 25% BBA stake to BMW at a fair multiple, which Bloomberg reported was explored in 2024, would crystallise this case faster.
scenario_narratives.bear: The H1 FY2026 collapse is structural, not cyclical. Domestic premium NEVs keep taking share, BMW's China pricing stays under pressure through 2028, Neue Klasse volumes arrive but at thin margins, and BBA profit falls toward 4bn by FY2031 while BMW retains more cash inside BBA for EV capex so Brilliance's dividends lag earnings. Management redeploys holdco cash into 'strategic investments' in the auto value chain (JSA, Yuxin) that lose money, the listed-associate carrying value is impaired, and the governance history (Huachen restructuring, unauthorised pledged deposits) keeps the multiple at 5x.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the asset the company actually owns -- a 25% share of BBA's earnings -- rather than the consolidated cash flows of the sub-scale subsidiaries that happen to be in the accounts. The earnings claim is capitalised at a CNY cost of equity with the terminal multiple capped at the stock's own historical 5-8x range so no re-rating is assumed; holdco net cash is added after deducting the already-paid September interim dividend and the minorities' share. At HK$1.80 the market pays roughly HK$1.1/share above post-dividend net cash for a stake earning ~RMB 1.7bn this depressed year, i.e. under 3x trough look-through earnings. The model says that is too cheap even on the bear path, but the gap is a judgment on BMW China and on whether the cash keeps being returned, not on arithmetic.
key_risks_to_valuation: BBA earnings path: every 10% change in the FY2027+ look-through earnings path moves value by roughly RMB 0.3/share; H1 FY2026 was -53% YoY and H2 could be worse than the ~790m assumed

Dividend capacity vs earnings: BBA has paid out above its earnings FY2023-25 (carrying value 16.7bn -> 9.7bn); if BMW retains cash for Neue Klasse capex, Brilliance's cash receipts fall below the modelled flow and WHT timing shifts

Cash redeployment: the Chairman explicitly seeks 'suitable strategic investments'; cash invested in JSA, Yuxin or acquisitions rather than returned would convert the ~RMB 2.9bn post-dividend net cash into assets the market discounts heavily
Terminal multiple: the 7x cap is itself the holdco discount; at 10x Gordon the base value would be ~RMB 0.45/share higher, at 5x ~RMB 0.3 lower
BMW buyout of the remaining 25% at a price set between an SOE-controlled seller and a motivated buyer -- could crystallise value above the price, or lock in a low multiple
Governance: unauthorised pledged-deposit losses 2019-21 and the Huachen restructuring; the listed HK associate is carried at 558m against a 79m market value
FX: RMB flows against an HKD quote; a 5% RMB move shifts every HKD per-share value by 5%

inputs.base_revenue_definition: NOT consolidated revenue. The engine's 'revenue' line is the Group's attributable share of results of associates and joint ventures (BBA 25% stake dominates), FY2026E in RMB millions: H1 FY2026 actual 912.0 (associates 974.0 less JV -62.0; interim p.5) plus H2 FY2026E ~790 (BBA H2 profit assumed ~3.2-3.3bn vs H1 3,874m, continued price-cut pressure, Neue Klasse iX3 only starting to ship; other associates/JV ~-60m). FY2025 actual was 2,504.2; FY2024 4,361.4.
inputs.cash_definition: 30-Jun-2026 cash and cash equivalents 4,444.9 plus unrestricted time deposits over 3 months 1,637.9 (interim note 17). Pledged and restricted short-term deposits of 509.8 are EXCLUDED. Debt is short-term bank borrowings 124.2 (interim note 23); lease liabilities (~114m) excluded, see lease_treatment.
inputs.last_fcf_definition: FY2026E distributable look-through earnings = 1,700 x (1 - 18% subsidiary/corporate drag) x (1 - 5% PRC withholding tax). This is the flow the model capitalises; it is NOT reported FCF.
inputs.reported_fcf_note: FY2025 OCF -579.3 less capex 226.2. Meaningless for this holdco: BBA dividends received (FY2025 4,287.9m; FY2024 7,654.0m) sit in INVESTING cash flows, so reported OCF/FCF carry only the loss-making subsidiaries.
inputs.sbc_source: zero: share option scheme adopted June 2019 but 'The Company had no outstanding share option at both 30th June, 2026 and 31st December, 2025' (interim p.36); no share-based payment expense in any annual cash flow statement FY2018-FY2025. SBC-zero market; house and street coincide.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 interest income 124.2m (H1 FY2026 21.1m) is EXCLUDED from the flow because the cash that earns it is added in the bridge (matching-asset rule).
inputs.fx_note: Model currency CNY (RMB) -> quote currency HKD at CNYHKD=X 1.1728 (Yahoo Finance, 2026-10-16T03:51Z). Parity check: HKDCNY=X 0.8518 at the same minute, 1/0.8518 = 1.1740, a 0.1% tie confirming rate and direction. No dual listing exists for a listing-parity check. Interim dividend HK$0.50 x 5,045.27m shares = HK$2,522.6m = RMB 2,150.9m at this rate.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T03:46:36Z (11:46 HKT, live intraday during the morning session; 52-week range 1.70-4.45; the stock is at the bottom of its range)
inputs.share_count_basis: 5,045,269,000 ordinary shares, unchanged FY2018-H1 FY2026; no options, convertibles or awards outstanding, so basic = fully diluted. Held flat.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity, not WACC: the flow is an equity-accounted earnings share, already post BBA-level tax and financing, so it is capitalised at the cost of equity and the holdco's own net cash is added separately. Built in CNY: China 10-year CGB ~1.8% + China equity risk premium ~7.0% (incl. country risk) x beta 1.2 for a cyclical premium-auto earnings stream = ~10.2%, rounded to 10.0%. Same rate in all three scenarios (risk is charged once, in the scenario paths and weights). The 7x terminal cap, not the discount rate, carries the holdco/no-control discount: Brilliance has traded at 5-8x look-through P/E for most of a decade.
inputs.lease_treatment: Leases immaterial (lease liabilities RMB 113.9m at FY2025, inside the consolidated subsidiaries). Treatment (B) by construction: lease costs are inside the subsidiaries' segment results that form the drag, and lease liabilities are excluded from net debt. Not charged twice.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are attributable: the 'margin' drag is the subsidiaries' and corporate net loss attributable to equity holders (FY2025 total drag -314m pre-tax of which NCI absorbed -123m). The bridge deducts NCI at book (895.5m = total equity 21,506.4 less attributable 20,610.9 at 30-Jun-2026) because the bridge adds 100% of CONSOLIDATED cash, part of which sits inside the part-owned auto-finance (BBAFC) and JSA subsidiaries. This is not a double charge: the subsidiaries contribute no positive value in the flows, so the only NCI claim being removed is on the cash the bridge adds.
inputs.notes: MODEL: Holdco look-through earnings capitalisation at cost of equity, run through the Drivers/engine route with D&A, capex, SBC, working capital all zero so FCF = look-through earnings x (1 - drag) x (1 - 5% WHT). WHY: Brilliance China is an investment holding company; consolidated revenue (~RMB1.2bn) comes from sub-scale, loss-making subsidiaries (JSA/Jinbei minibuses, Ningbo Yumin and Mianyang Ruian components, BBAFC auto finance) while essentially all profit is the equity-accounted 25% share of BMW Brilliance Automotive (BBA profit FY2024 17,450m, FY2025 10,388m, H1 FY2026 3,874m vs 8,206m). An owner-FCF DCF on consolidated cash flow would value the loss-making subsidiaries and ignore the asset. A BVPS x exit-P/B model fails because book (RMB 4.08/share) is being deliberately run down by dividends above earnings (FY2023-25 paid out 44bn of BBA disposal proceeds and dividends). The routing table has no exact row for a single-JV holdco, so the parts are summed: (1) the BBA earnings claim capitalised at CoE, (2) holdco net cash at 30-Jun-2026 less the HK$0.50 interim dividend paid 24-Sep-2026 (the price is ex) and less NCI, (3) subsidiaries carried as a negative drag inside the flow rather than valued. TAX: 5% is the HK-treaty withholding on dividends remitted from the PRC intermediate holdco to the Bermuda/HK parent; observed FY2023 476/8,750, FY2024 1,474/27,211, FY2025 445/8,423 = 5.3-5.4%. BBA earnings are already after 25% PRC CIT. GOVERNANCE: the controlling shareholder Huachen went through court restructuring 2020-24 and RMB billions of Group deposits were pledged without authorisation for related-party facilities in 2019-21; this history plus a 25% non-controlling stake is why the terminal cap is held at the stock's own 5-8x historical P/E range and why the bear weight is above house default. The listed HK associate is carried at 558m against a 79m market value (interim note 12) -- an impairment risk that would hit reported earnings, not the flow modelled here.

bear.growth_rationale: H1 FY2026's -53% run-rate continues into 2027: Neue Klasse does not stop share loss to Xiaomi/Li Auto/NIO/Zeekr, the price war persists through 2028 (AlixPartners), BMW keeps cutting China list prices, and BBA retains cash for its own EV capex so dividends lag earnings. Look-through earnings fall to ~0.9bn by FY2031 (BBA ~4bn) and keep eroding -3%/yr. No terminal growth; 5x cap.
bear.ebitda_margin_rationale: Absolute drag of ~-280m on a shrinking earnings base: JSA stays sub-scale and loss-making, Yuxin JV losses persist, BBAFC margins compress further.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 is BMW China's trough (BMW 2026 auto EBIT guidance cut to 1-3%, BBA H1 local sales -18.8%, H1 profit -53%). Neue Klasse iX3 (Shenyang-built, 2026) and the i3 successor (2027) plus the RMB10bn sixth-gen battery plant restore part of BBA's BEV competitiveness: look-through earnings recover ~30% by FY2029 to ~2.3bn (BBA ~9.4bn, still below FY2025's 10.4bn and barely half of FY2024), then fade -1%/yr as premium-ICE share keeps leaking to domestic NEV brands. The JV term runs to 2040; terminal growth 0%.
base.ebitda_margin_rationale: Margin = 1 - (attributable subsidiary/corporate drag / look-through earnings). Drag: FY2024 -255m pre-tax, FY2025 -314m (NCI absorbed -123m), H1 FY2026 -170m incl. finance costs (NCI -18m). Base assumes attributable drag of ~-340m in FY2027 (JSA restart losses, Yuxin cockpit JV ramp) narrowing to ~-180m by FY2032 as JSA volumes and KD exports scale and the TCL JV reaches breakeven.
base.cash_tax_rationale: 5% PRC withholding tax on dividends remitted offshore (HK treaty rate; observed 5.3-5.4% FY2023-25). BBA's 25% CIT is already inside the equity-accounted earnings.
base.terminal_rationale: Gordon at 10%/0% = 10x would exceed the 5-8x look-through P/E the stock has carried since 2018; cap held at 7x so the model does not assume a re-rating of a non-controlling, no-growth, PRC-concentrated earnings stream.

bull.growth_rationale: Neue Klasse lands in China (iX3/i3 take BBA's BEV mix from ~9% toward 25-30%), the price war abates by 2028 as weaker NEV entrants consolidate, and BMW's China margin normalises toward its pre-2025 level. Look-through earnings reach ~3.1bn by FY2031 (BBA ~12.5bn: above FY2025, still below FY2024's 17.5bn). Terminal growth 1%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 7x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 35%: the business is a single non-controlling stake in one associate whose profit has halved year on year, the counterparty (BMW) has just cut its own guidance, the dividend was cut, and the controlling-shareholder/governance history is poor. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things to go right: Neue Klasse product success, an end to the China price war, and BMW maintaining BBA payouts while funding its own EV capex. Base 45% is the residual.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
